system_requirements.notes: Shared Slicer runtime. The Eagle Eye edition also requires portable Brain/SynthSeg with volBrain reference assets and Lumbar/vertebrae_mr. No runtime model downloads. notes: Slicer is shared across editions. Eagle Eye owns Brain and Lumbar features; its installer component requires both complete offline payloads and documented Brain distribution evidence. Standard/ARM exclude Eagle Eye model assets. Anatomy assistance only; not a validated autonomous diagnosis.
